checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (YuiEucl n)),
  0 ≤ n →
    E.Nonempty →
      IsCompact E →
        ((∀ (k : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)) (a : ℝ),
              0 < a →
                YuiMeasure a A = (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure a) A ∧
                  (dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal a → YuiMeasure a A = 0) ∧
                    (ENNReal.ofReal a < dimH A → YuiMeasure a A = ∞) ∧
                      (YuiMeasure a A = 0 → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a) ∧
                        (YuiMeasure a A = ∞ → ENNReal.ofReal a ≤ dimH A)) ∧
            (∀ (k : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)), 0 ≤ dimH A) ∧
              (∀ (k : ℕ) (A B : Set (YuiEucl k)), A ⊆ B → dimH A ≤ dimH B) ∧
                ∀ (k l : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)) (g : ↑A → YuiEucl l), Isometry g → dimH (Set.range g) = dimH A) →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun k => 1 / ↑(k + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
            ∀ (u v : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞),
              (∀ᶠ (k : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, u k ≤ v k) → Filter.liminf u Filter.atTop ≤ Filter.liminf v Filter.atTop
